newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Cera seals Indosuez Bank Belgium acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Cera seals Indosuez Bank Belgium acquisition.

text.p: Belgian Cera Bank and French Credit Agricole Indosuez have finalised negotiations about the acquisition by Cera Bank of 80 percent of the shares of Indosuez Bank Belgium, Cera said in a statement on Wednesday.
Cera said that Credit Agricole Indosuez has made a cooperation agreement with Indosuez Bank Belgium, of which it still holds 19.8 percent.
The bank's name will be changed into "CERA Investment Bank".
The planned acquisiton was announced late last year.
Cera also said that the synergy scenario between both banks stipulates that all dealing room activities will be concentrated in Brussels.
Cera chairman Willy Breesch said in February one of the two banks would give up its status as primary dealer of Belgian state debt when the takeover became effective.
